statement: A 20-variety blueberry trial covering northern highbush, southern highbush and rabbiteye types was established in 2021 at the University of Arkansas Fruit Research Station, Clarksville, Arkansas, on the zone 7b/8a boundary, with weekly harvests from 21 May to 2 August 2024 in the first harvest season. Highest yields were from the rabbiteye varieties Alapaha and Vernon at about 10 lb of marketable fruit per plant, while a mid-March freeze cut southern and northern highbush yields to under 1 lb per plant in some cases.
